saic-1988-thermal-table.citation: Science Applications International Corporation (1988), Gulf of Mexico Physical Oceanography Program Final Report: Year 3, Volume II: Technical Report. OCS Study MMS 88-0046, U.S. Department of the Interior, Minerals Management Service, September 1988.
saic-1988-thermal-table.access: Original government report acquired. Table 4.4-2, printed page 170 / PDF page 194, visually verified against the source pixels. Areas are printed tabular thermal-level diagnostics, not digitized map estimates or full outer-boundary areas.

hamilton-1999.citation: Hamilton, Fargion and Biggs (1999), Loop Current Eddy Paths in the Western Gulf of Mexico, Journal of Physical Oceanography 29, 1180–1207.
hamilton-1999.access: Publisher-indexed primary article introduction reviewed for the explicit alias Fast Eddy / eddy B and 1985–1986 slope interaction. Direct article open returned HTTP 403; original PDF bytes and pages not acquired. Used as alias context, not as a source of copied dimensions.

records.case_label: Fast / Eddy B thermal-level source table
records.period_label: 1985-10 source survey label; exact per-contour observation dates unspecified
records.definition: Area enclosed by the 750 m depth contour of the 8 degree Celsius temperature surface in the source survey labelled 1985-10.
records.scope: Named Fast / Eddy B source case, qualified published alias only. Registry initial separation is 1985-05-31; report context is early July 1985. Physical identity and separation conventions remain unreconciled.
records.qualification: Thermal-level enclosed area, not the full eddy outer boundary or thickness. Source planimeter readings from hand-contoured hydrographic surveys; original samples and measurement uncertainty unavailable. Survey-month labels can include cruises crossing month boundaries. Different contour levels are not a seasonal range. No diameter, footprint, lifetime, ranking, state containment or seasonal playback inferred.
records.source_locator: Table 4.4-2, printed page 170 / PDF page 194; accompanying methods and closed-contour discussion on printed page 166 / PDF page 190.
